# PrismaLens

> An open-source app on your machine that hands signals to your coding agent and keeps the evidence.

PrismaLens runs on macOS and Linux, with Windows in preview. It brings no model of its own: it drives a coding agent you already use, such as OpenCode, Claude Code or Codex. It needs no account and is licensed Apache-2.0. Findings are ranked and backed by evidence, never scored.

## Docs

- [Docs index for agents](https://docs.prismalens.io/llms.txt): every docs page as Markdown, with a one-line summary each

- [What PrismaLens is](https://docs.prismalens.io/index.md): what it does and what it keeps
- [Install, upgrade and uninstall](https://docs.prismalens.io/install.md): one command per channel
- [Quick start](https://docs.prismalens.io/quickstart.md): first run to first report
